Reformat a qesR codebook (legacy)

Source: R/codebook.R
format_codebook.Rd

Soft-deprecated: use qes_codebook(codebook, layout = ), which lays a codebook out again. format_codebook() keeps working and will not be removed; it prints a one-time notice (see qesR-deprecated).

Usage

format_codebook(codebook, layout = c("compact", "wide", "long"))

Arguments

codebook

A qes_codebook object from qes_codebook().

layout

One of "compact", "wide", or "long".

Value

The codebook in the requested layout (see qes_codebook()).

Details

The long layout keeps the variables that have no value labels, with one row whose value is NA. A plain data frame, for example a codebook read back from a CSV file (which loses its class and attributes), is an error of class qesR_error_input: rebuild it with qes_codebook("<code>").

See also

qes_codebook(), and qesR-deprecated for the legacy functions and their replacements.

Other legacy: download_codebook(), get_codebook(), get_codebook_files(), get_decon(), get_preview(), get_qescodes(), get_question(), get_value_labels()

Examples

cb <- qes_codebook("qes2014", variables = c("Q2", "Q19"))
format_codebook(cb, layout = "long")
#> `format_codebook()` is soft-deprecated; use `qes_codebook(codebook, layout = )`. It keeps working and will not be removed.
